prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, during a cloudy sunset. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the rugged terrain of large, dark rocks scattered across the beach. As the viewer progresses, the camera pans slightly to reveal the expansive ocean stretching into the horizon under a dimly lit sky, painted with hues of deep orange and purple. The surrounding environment is shrouded in a misty fog, creating a serene and isolated atmosphere. The camera continues its journey, navigating through dense patches of shrubs and bushes that line the beach, their silhouettes stark against the fading light. The movement is smooth, with occasional shifts in angle to highlight the natural contours of the landscape. The waves gently crash onto the shore, their white foam contrasting with the darker tones of the sand and rocks. The overall scene remains empty, devoid of any human presence, emphasizing the untouched beauty of this outdoor-natural setting. The lighting gradually dims as the sun sets further, casting long shadows and adding depth to the rocky formations and vegetation. The video concludes with a final panoramic view of the beach, encapsulating the tranquil and majestic essence of Castle Rock Beach at sunset.
